prompt: Xcode supports external observer hooks for post-tool and other non-critical runtime events. A slow or failing observer currently runs inline with event emission, delaying the coding loop and allowing observer failures to interrupt Agent progress. Preserve the blocking semantics of pre-tool control hooks, but make non-critical external observer hooks non-blocking and isolate their failures while retaining a deterministic way to drain pending work during controlled shutdown or tests. Do not modify tests. Run focused tests and avoid unrelated changes.
known_limitations: The deterministic oracle uses thread synchronization around a local runner double; it does not execute a slow third-party observer process during grading.

The historical synchronous non-pre event wiring test is intentionally excluded because the expected behavior changes to background completion; regression checks retain external execution redaction and blocking pre-tool semantics instead.
